title: Quantum Belief Characterization: A Multi-Shot Notion of Equivalence
summary: A recent formulation of quantum belief showed that quantum retrodiction depends not only on the reduced density operator of the system of interest, but also on correlations with a hidden reference system, which leads to the notion of quantum belief equivalence. In this paper we formulate a multi-shot problem, where the extended posterior obtained after one update is used again as the prior for the next update.
